source: Ed4 C.6.2, pp.C-68 to C-70; C.7.6.3.2, p.C-122; corpus-format.md 6.2
description: A peer recorded Ed3 gets ED3-BASIC-RATE coded from the MAX-SPEED rung by our table, Other Parameters 10, never an Ed4 recommendation.
note: Table (corpus-format.md 6.1): ladder WN 2, 4, 6, 7 at Long (positions 0 to 3); thresholds measured on WN 2 Long bulk -100, 50, 150, 300 and latency -100, 100, 200, 400; on WN 4 Long bulk -100, 0, 100, 150 and latency -100, 100, 300, 400; on WN 6 Long bulk -100, 0, 300, 500 and latency -100, 200, 400, 600; on WN 7 Long bulk -100, -50, 100, 400 and latency -100, 0, 300, 600; smoothing weight 8, clean run 2, error limit 500 ppt, caps 2 doubling to 8 bursts. As drc-empty-to-ed3-peer: at 2000 a type 8 from 0.0.1.3 with a PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST, Ed4 clear, records it Ed3 (B-0227, B-0408); here its burst ends on WN 6 Long with estimate 150, so MAX-SPEED would be WN 4 Long (bulk target position 1). At 52000 the PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED goes in a type 8 to 0.0.1.3 whose EOW is ED3-BASIC-RATE (C-0957, C-0959) instead of EMPTY: by our C-0442 table (interp C-1273) WN 4 is 1200 bps, code 0100 (C-0432), Long is long, 10 (C-0435), Other Parameters 10, DRC advisory (C-0440): contents 0x4A, EOW 0x14A. Never MAX-SPEED or another Ed4 EOW (C-0419, C-0938). The rest is drc-empty-to-ed3-peer's flow.
